deviation_mechanism: The ±15 nm thickness constraint artificially truncates the optical path length search space. In multilayer interference stacks, reflectance is governed by cumulative phase shifts φ = 2πnd/λ. Restricting d to ±15 nm around initial guesses caps the tunable phase window, preventing the optimizer from reaching the precise destructive/constructive interference condition required for scores >0.93. The design is trapped in a local optimum where micro-adjustments cannot overcome the residual spectral mismatch driving the gap between 0.9207 and 0.9300.
continue_rationale: Round 4 improved best_target_score by only 4.7e-4 (0.92020→0.92067), falling below the 1e-3 exhaustion threshold, but this stagnation spans exactly one round, failing the two-consecutive-rounds stop condition. The pool remains robust with valid_candidates=9 and tightest_margin=0.3999 well above the 0.30 relaxation trigger. A single sub-threshold gain does not justify halting; expanding the search volume is warranted to test whether the bottleneck is topological or purely bounded by the current constraint box.
